records.title: Dispatch Loom
records.subtitle: Dispatch reconciliation tool
records.summary: An internal operational tool for dispatch-desk reconciliation of mismatched references. Operators compared an overnight spreadsheet with the daily export; the tool surfaced understandable exceptions, including visible warnings for late source files and visible empty rows. Ada personally built the Python parser and SQL checks, using Git for version control and PostgreSQL for the production database. Supervisors made final dispatch decisions.
records.source_quote: At Harbor Tools I personally designed and built Dispatch Loom, a dispatch reconciliation tool, using Python and SQL.
uncertainties: Grounding UNSUPPORTED: The summary presents visible late-file warnings as a feature the tool surfaced, but the source only says operators preferred such a warning. The source does not establish that this preference was implemented.
